'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Mason LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Mason]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title scribbled out. Shield block lines 1–4 list systems (kept as on sheet). Imperial Atrocity (V)×10; Artoo×6.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Mason]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will No Longer Support|Hidden Base]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
